offers_products.reason: Manufactures frozen french fries, potato appetizers, sweet potato and vegetable products.

offers_services.reason: Sells manufactured frozen potato goods; no main service offering beyond product support.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Focuses on foodservice operators and restaurants; some retail frozen items exist but are secondary.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to restaurants, foodservice operators, chains and retailers who buy fries for resale or serving.

recurring_revenue.reason: Restaurants and chains repeatedly reorder frozen fries and potato products as ongoing food supplies.

cyclical_demand.reason: Staple food sold to restaurants; demand is fairly steady, though restaurant traffic dips somewhat.

big_ticket.reason: Frozen fries are small, frequent supply purchases by restaurants.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured potato products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large restaurant chains and major foodservice distributors and retailers.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns farmland and operates many potato processing plants needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Consumer sales through retail exist but are secondary to foodservice.
